overview: IU Dehradun campus life spans academics, clubs, sports, cultural events and industry interface, on a 25-acre, Wi-Fi enabled campus at Selaqui, Dehradun with roughly 2.3 lakh sq. ft. of built-up area.
campus_infrastructure: Academic blocks, workshops, laboratories, faculty rooms, auditorium, seminar halls, computer labs, library, canteen and sports/recreation facilities.
Latest teaching aids across classrooms, with a strong emphasis on industry-university interface.
Full-time campus-based programs offered in Management, Science & Technology, Education and Law at Bachelor, Master and Ph.D levels.

infrastructure.it_facilities: More than 350 networked computers across campus, standard office productivity and specialized software (including statistical tools like SPSS and CAD tools like ANSYS/Pro-E), with campus-wide Wi-Fi.
infrastructure.computing: Computer labs support both coursework and research, with regular hardware/software upgrades.
infrastructure.health_centre: An on-campus First Aid room and ambulance, with a visiting medical practitioner available multiple times a week.
infrastructure.placements_cell: A full-time Placement Cell coordinates placement activities and summer internship programs across all disciplines.
infrastructure.sports_facilities: Indoor and select outdoor sports and recreational facilities are available on campus.
infrastructure.library: The central library holds over 30,713 volumes and 13,558 titles across Management, Education, Engineering and Law, is open 9 AM - 6 PM on working days, and uses an automated OPAC search system.
infrastructure.library_extras: The library subscribes to 93+ print periodicals, is an active DELNET member, and provides access to the URKUND anti-plagiarism tool through INFLIBNET.
infrastructure.hostel_accommodation: Outstation students are accommodated through the university's list of empanelled hostels near the Selaqui campus rather than university-owned dormitories.

student_support.note: The Admission Office is open Monday-Saturday during standard hours and additionally on Saturdays & Sundays during peak admission season.
